facts.fact: Kai 豪宅晨间全按角度归位，但多年来头一次走神想起昨晚酒吧的女人——记得笑声和森林绿毛衣，不记得名字
facts.anchor: He remembered her laugh and the forest-green sweater, but not her name.

facts.fact: Marcus 通知：与 Yna Martinez 的会议定在 11 点，审最新手稿，地点是她喜欢的咖啡馆
facts.anchor: Meeting with Yna Martinez confirmed for 11:00 AM.

facts.fact: Kai 知道这个名字：黑暗奇幻作家、名声混乱、拒绝企业游戏；经纪人数月来催他把人签进更结构化的管理合同
facts.anchor: the dark fantasy author who had somehow become a household staple despite her chaotic reputation

facts.fact: 手稿修订凌晨 2 点送达，附言「需要往页面上放血」才能睡；她要求在她的老地方见面，称自己办公室是 hostile territory
facts.anchor: needed to bleed onto the page

facts.fact: 她的书连续 22 周在畅销榜；读者忠诚近乎邪教；Kai 评她「包在混乱里的金矿」；她躲避面对面会议三年
facts.anchor: Her books had stayed on the bestseller list for twenty-two consecutive weeks.

facts.fact: 页边空白全是她的红笔狂草（魔法太多需更多血/让暗君更可怜）；Kai 定性 messy、unprofessional、而 brilliant
facts.anchor: make the dark lord more pathetic.

facts.fact: 送学路上 Elizabeth 嘲她 vibrating with stress；Yna 纠正「我不是震动，我是管理」；Lynne 讨价还价成功——晚饭吃塔可
facts.anchor: I am not vibrating, I am managing

facts.fact: 握手瞬间 Kai 认出：昨晚酒吧的女人=他追签三年的作者；他压住着迷只说 Your work is exceptional
facts.anchor: was the exact same woman who had been disrupting his thoughts all morning.
